rules: When AVF_ACCESS_CODE is configured, protected API routes reject missing or invalid bearer tokens with 401.
When AVF_PROVIDER=openai, AVF_ACCESS_CODE is mandatory and must be at least 12 characters.
Successful login returns an opaque expiring session token; the raw access code is never returned.
Failed login attempts are rate-limited and generation requests have a per-session hourly quota.
Health and the HTML shell remain public; generation/config/job/video APIs are protected when auth is enabled.
